question: Training sessions will be held ------- Monday and Wednesday afternoons.
explanation: 特定の 曜日の 午後には on を 使う。

question: Parking is available directly ------- from the main entrance.
explanation: across from ～（～の 向かい側に）の 決まった 表現。

question: The manager reviewed the proposal ------- making her final decision.
explanation: 動名詞 making の 前に 置ける 前置詞 before が 正解。prior は prior to の 形が 必要。

question: Ms. Ito was promoted ------- her outstanding sales performance.
explanation: 「～が 認められて」を 表す in recognition of が 文意に 合う。

question: ------- the contract expires in June, the two companies are already negotiating a new agreement.
explanation: 節を 導き「～だが（まだ 先なのに）」と 譲歩を 表す 接続詞 Although が 正解。

question: The seminar will be postponed ------- enough people register.
explanation: 「十分な 人数が 登録しない 限り 延期」と なる 接続詞 unless が 正解。

question: All prices listed in the catalog are subject to change ------- notice.
explanation: without notice（予告 なしに）の 決まった 表現。
tags: 前置詞 コロケーション

question: Visitors must remain ------- the designated areas at all times.
explanation: remain within ～（～の 範囲内に とどまる）が 正解。

question: ------- reviewing the applications, the committee will contact the finalists.
explanation: 動名詞 reviewing の 前に 置ける 前置詞は After だけ。

question: Mr. Lund prepared the presentation slides -------, without any help from his team.
explanation: 「自分で」と 強調する 再帰代名詞 himself が 正解。

question: The employees ------- completed the survey will receive a gift card.
explanation: 先行詞が 人で、関係詞節の 主語に なるので who。

question: The conference center, ------- was renovated last year, can hold 800 guests.
explanation: コンマの 後の 非制限用法で 物を 受けるのは which。that は 使えない。

question: Please return the signed contract to ------- at your earliest convenience.
explanation: 前置詞 to の 目的語なので 目的格 us。

question: Mr. Kaur, ------- team won the sales award, will speak at the banquet.
explanation: 後ろの 名詞 team に つながる 所有格の 関係代名詞 whose。

question: Staff members should log off ------- computers before leaving the office.
explanation: 名詞 computers の 前なので 所有格 their。

question: The new copier is much faster than ------- we used last year.
explanation: 前に 出た copier を 受ける the one（we used ～ が 後ろから 修飾）が 正解。

question: The manager praised the interns, many of ------- had never worked in an office before.
explanation: 前置詞 of の 後で 人を 受ける 関係代名詞は whom。them では 文が つながらない。

question: This is the restaurant ------- the awards banquet will be held.
explanation: 後ろが 完全な 文で 場所を 表すので 関係副詞 where。

question: Ms. Fischer and I will present ------- findings at the board meeting.
explanation: 名詞 findings の 前なので 所有格 our。

question: ------- who wish to attend the workshop should register online.
explanation: Those who ～（～する 人々）の 形。

question: Mr. Romero's report was more detailed than -------.
explanation: 比べるのは「報告書」どうしなので 所有代名詞 mine（＝my report）。

question: The board approved the plan ------- the finance director had proposed.
explanation: 先行詞 the plan を 受け、proposed の 目的語に なる 関係代名詞 that。

question: The technicians repaired the elevator ------- in less than an hour.
explanation: 「自分たちで」と 主語を 強調する 再帰代名詞 themselves。

question: Ms. Grant will meet with ------- is interested in the volunteer program.
explanation: with の 目的語に なり、節内で is の 主語に なる 複合関係代名詞 whoever。

question: The supplier ------- we usually order from has raised its prices.
explanation: from の 目的語に なる 関係代名詞 that が 正解。where では from が 余る。

question: Each department must submit ------- own budget proposal by Friday.
explanation: own の 前は 所有格。department（単数）に 合う its。

question: Please ------- the attached file and let me know if you have any questions.
explanation: 目的語 the attached file を 取り「確認する」の 意味に なる review。reply・respond は to が 必要。

question: The company plans to ------- its operations to three new cities next year.
explanation: expand A to B（A を B に 拡大する）が 文意に 合う。

question: All visitors must ------- a valid form of identification at the front desk.
explanation: 身分証を「提示する」は present。

question: The ------- for submitting proposals has been extended to June 15.
explanation: 延長されるのは「締め切り」deadline。

question: Ms. Ward was ------- to the position of head chef after five years at the restaurant.
explanation: be promoted to ～（～に 昇進する）が 正解。

question: The hotel provides a free shuttle service to and from the -------.
explanation: シャトルが 往復する 場所なので airport。

question: Due to the bad weather, the outdoor event has been ------- until next weekend.
explanation: until next weekend と 組み「延期された」を 表す postponed。

question: The damaged parts will be replaced free of charge because the product is still under -------.
explanation: under warranty（保証期間中で）の 決まった 表現。
tags: 語彙 コロケーション

question: Our customer service team is well ------- to handle a wide range of inquiries.
explanation: be equipped to do（～する 能力・準備が ある）が 正解。
tags: 語彙 コロケーション

question: The finance department will ------- the expense reports before reimbursing employees.
explanation: 払い戻しの 前に 経費報告を「確認する」verify。
